subject: Progress bar not working properly with some themes from bootswatch

messages.author: e2ca5093917af03b
messages.subject: Progress bar not working properly with some themes from bootswatch
parts:
I fixed it temporarily be removing all progress Bar rules out of the .css file, then defining it by hand / tags in UI.r file i.e.




  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
   .shiny-progress .bar {
    background-color: #FF0000;
      .opacity = 1;
  }
 .shiny-progress .progress {
    height:9px;
  }"))
  )
